facts.text: Jon expresses a desire to create a place for people to dance and express themselves, which he describes as a dream.

evidence.quote: I hope so, Gina. I want to create a place for people to dance and express themselves - it's been a dream of mine.
Dancing is like second nature to me. I'm living my dream by having my own dance studio and teaching others.

facts.text: Gina acknowledges Jon's dream and believes his dance studio will make a significant positive impact.

evidence.quote: Giving people a place to express themselves with dance is really important. Your studio is gonna make a huge difference.
Your studio will totally change things for lots of folks.

facts.text: Jon thanks Gina for her support and promises to keep her updated on the progress of his dance studio.

evidence.quote: Thanks! Your help means a lot. Keep you posted on the dance studio progress.

facts.text: Gina mentions she had an interview for a design internship the previous day and found it exciting.

evidence.quote: Oh, btw, I had an interview for a design internship yesterday! It was so cool.
